minimal_master_hint: A minimal order master, kept here only because the factory has no merchandising system to read it from. It holds what production planning needs and nothing else.
no_styles: No styles on this order yet.
bom_hint: What one garment consumes, in the item’s own unit. The wastage allowance is added on top when the requirement is worked out — it is what the factory plans to lose, not what it actually lost.
no_bom: No bill of materials yet — the requirement cannot be worked out without one.
issue_hint: Measured against the bill of materials as it goes. An issue that takes the programme past the factory’s tolerance waits for a sign-off — and the stock stays in the store until it has one.
stock_not_moved: Nothing has left the store yet — this issue is waiting for approval.
variance_approval_title: :item on :number is :percent% over the bill of materials.
no_issues: Nothing has been issued to this programme yet.
item_not_in_bom: :item is not on this style’s bill of materials.
program_not_issuable: A :status programme cannot be issued to.
unknown_style: That style is not available to your company.
style_no_taken: Style :style is already on this order.
item_twice_in_bom: :item is on the bill of materials twice.
program_exceeds_style: Only :remaining of style :style are left to programme.
